page_title: BOU 5-0 NOT | Bournemouth v Nottingham Forest 25/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+9' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from the edge of the box. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
90+9' Bournemouth get the opportunity to endanger the opposition's goal with a free kick from the edge of the box.
90+6' The linesman points to the corner flag, Nottingham are going to take it.
90+3' Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+2' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Dango Ouattara is replaced by Zain Silcott-Duberry (Bournemouth).
90+1' 5 - 0 Goal! Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Marcus Tavernier, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 5:0.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
88' A substitution has been made. Justin Kluivert goes off and Daniel Jebbison (Bournemouth) comes on.
87' 4 - 0 Goal! Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Matz Sels and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 4:0.
80' Here comes a substitution. David Brooks is given a rest as he is replaced by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth).
79' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ramon Sosa (Nottingham) replacing Ola Aina.
79' Morgan Gibbs-White goes off the pitch and Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) comes on.
74' Great teamplay by Nottingham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
72' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) decides to have a direct shot at goal from the free kick, but the ball hits the right post.
71' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
70' Nottingham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
66' The substitution has been made. Alex Moreno (Nottingham) has replaced Neco Williams.
66' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to substitute Jota Silva and he is replaced by Morato (Nottingham).
64' Jota Silva (Nottingham) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
61' 3 - 0 Goal - 3:0! Tyler Adams laid the ball off to Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
60' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Bournemouth players look gutted.
59' The Bournemouth players halt their celebrations as referee Craig Pawson makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
59' Morato (Nottingham) gets a yellow card, off the field.
59' Although Ramon Sosa (Nottingham) is just on the bench, Craig Pawson has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
58' Goal! Dango Ouattara shows great vision to find Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 3:0.

55' 2 - 0 Justin Kluivert displays his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross deep into the box. Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) gets onto the scoresheet by superbly heading it into the top left corner – 2:0.
55' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
51' The resulting set piece from Nottingham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
51' Nottingham earn a corner.
51' A brilliant cross into the box finds Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham), who directs his header towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
48' David Brooks (Bournemouth) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.

47' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) rises high to head a nice lofted cross low towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Matz Sels makes a comfortable save.
46' Half-time substitution. Nuno Espirito Santo decided to make a change. Ryan Yates is replaced by Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham).
46' The whistle blows and Craig Pawson starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Neco Williams (Nottingham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
43' Nottingham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
43' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
42' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
41' Bournemouth have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
39' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
39' Murillo (Nottingham) receives a pass from Anthony Elanga and attempts to score from the edge of the box, but the shot slips well wide of the right post.
35' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
34' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) jumps into a tackle and Craig Pawson signals a foul.
30' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
29' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
27' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

26' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Matz Sels makes a great save to stop the effort going into the bottom left corner.
25' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 64:36.
21' David Brooks (Bournemouth) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the left post.
21' Chance! Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards goal, but Matz Sels is alert and makes a great save to deny him.

18' Chance! Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
15' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
15' The Bournemouth players are exchanging some short passes.
12' What a huge chance for Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
11' It will be a corner kick for Nottingham.
9' 1 - 0 What a beauty from just outside the box! Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom left corner.
7' Chris Wood (Nottingham) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
5' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) whips in a cross from the corner, but Matz Sels is well positioned and punches the ball away.
4' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
3' Ola Aina (Nottingham) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball goes out of play. Nottingham are awarded a corner kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Nottingham will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Craig Pawson.
